## Benchmark name

Name of the benchmark or dataset.

## Evaluation dimension

Which safety dimension does this benchmark address?
- [ ] Bias
- [ ] Toxicity
- [ ] Truthfulness
- [ ] Robustness
- [ ] Red Teaming / Adversarial Risk
- [ ] Other (describe below)

## Source and reference

Paper, dataset, or tool this is based on. Include a URL or DOI.

## Dataset availability

Is the dataset publicly available? Under what licence?

## Proposed metrics

What primary metric(s) would the adapter produce? How do they align with `docs/scoring.md`?

## Implementation notes

Any notes on dependencies, API keys required, computational cost, or known limitations.

## Governance and responsible use

Are there any ethical, privacy, or legal considerations for using this benchmark?
